market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100 on May 6. $120 requires ~20% rally over ~8 weeks. Recent peak $106. EIA Brent Q2 peak target is $115, implying WTI ~$110-112 max. Low probability without major supply shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Hormuz closure or Russian export sanctions could trigger spike.
